'''Kevin Brownell''' (forum handle '''CubsFan''') served as an advocate of the [[Players Committee]] for marketing and player relations.

He accepted an invitation to become the Marketing &amp; Player Relations Player Advocate in 2004. His role was to keep the community up to date on events and game news, on the official site and on other CCG websites. He also acted as a liaison between the PC and the playing community. He was also named a member of the PC's &ldquo;WebGroup&rdquo;, formed at the same time to coordinate the PC website.<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref>

On 15 February 2005 he announced on the PC forums that [[Scott Lingrell]] had accepted the position of Design Advocate.<ref name="pcf-4613">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050415124643/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4613&amp New Design Advocate!], Kevin Brownell (15 February 2005), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 15 April 2005.</ref> The Players Committee's errata of June 2006 credit him with the original concept of Combat Readiness (V) and Careful Planning (V) ("Kevin Brownell, Illinois States 2004").<ref name="pc-sid11">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220104/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=11 Current Errata - June 12/13, 2006 - PDF Update], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 June 2006.</ref>

== Card credits ==
Kevin Brownell is credited with the original concept of four Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: [[2004 Illinois State Championship|Illinois States 2004]]. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 4]] (cards first released 2002–2009) and [[Virtual Set 0]] (released 24 September 2014).
